scope: codeRoot/runtime-data/s3-native-artifacts: only known workbench live/tombstone run native files; historical development artifacts protected unknown
backend.statistics: lstat regular-file size, deduplicated dev/inode; protected+reclaimable+unknown=total. Symlink targets not traversed and hard links protected. statfs disk available bytes separate, no disk-space-release promise.
backend.reference_safety: All persisted JSON columns except deletion/request/storage management metadata; paper own source refs, any run/document/SHA/versions/reviews/events/exports. Explicit path/file_reference/directory/*_path references are conservative including ancestor directories; unknown-key strings count as paths only when resolved inside one of the five fixed managed roots. Literal native prose slash is not a filesystem root reference. Invalid JSON, unreadable run state or incomplete filesystem scan disables cleanup targets. Live run directories/native sources are protected including terminal and zero-candidate runs.
backend.unused_upload: Only uploaded paper with no run/document/SHA/historical reference and24h grace elapsed; whole shared paper group explicit; confirmed logical removal committed with recovery plan before any bytes unlink. Only exclusively owned known artifacts selected; unselected/live/shared references protected.
backend.concurrency: global cleanup gate fails409 if upload/preparing/active/queued/human/export/delete/pendingcleanup present. New writes fail409 while cleanup runs. Full scan version recheck then short per-candidate SQLite transactions with live all-reference checks; O_NOFOLLOW directory descriptors and exact dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime/mode/nlink leaf recheck; unlink only approved regular files, no recursive rm.
backend.recovery: partial per-candidate receipt reports actual unlinked regular-file sizes/files; logical paper removals explicit. Same preview+selection returns durable receipt; different selection409; remaining files require a new preview/confirmation. An interrupted executing plan does not resume at startup; explicit retry rechecks current file identity and references.
